definitions.explanation: The eighth planet from the Sun, the farthest of the solar system's planets. Composed of {海|かい} (sea) + {王|おう} (king) + {星|せい} (star/planet).

examples.japanese: {海王星|かいおうせい}は{太陽系|たいようけい}の{第八惑星|だいはちわくせい}だ。
examples.english: Neptune is the eighth planet in the solar system.

examples.japanese: {海王星|かいおうせい}は{青|あお}く{見|み}える{巨大|きょだい}な{惑星|わくせい}だ。
examples.english: Neptune is a giant planet that appears blue.

examples.japanese: {海王星|かいおうせい}は{太陽|たいよう}から{遠|とお}く、{公転周期|こうてんしゅうき}は{約|やく}{百六十五年|ひゃくろくじゅうごねん}だ。
examples.english: Neptune is far from the Sun, with an orbital period of about 165 years.

notes:
Named after Neptune, the Roman god of the sea — written with {海|かい} (sea) + {王|おう} (king) + {星|せい} (planet). The same pattern appears in other planet names: {水星|すいせい} (Mercury), {金星|きんせい} (Venus), {火星|かせい} (Mars), {木星|もくせい} (Jupiter), {土星|どせい} (Saturn), {天王星|てんのうせい} (Uranus).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海王星|かいおうせい}の{衛星|えいせい}: moons of Neptune
- {海王星|かいおうせい}の{大気|たいき}: Neptune's atmosphere
- {海王星|かいおうせい}を{観測|かんそく}する: to observe Neptune
